details:
a button that would be customizable to mix report features into one button For example a button to Block User, Report the user, Ban user from group, Kick user from instance, Mute user in stance, Open there Profile on the website and Ban them from the group, Personal Mute, Personal Voice Control

    When a user joins it shows how many times they've been Warned, Kicked and Banned from Groups and worlds in the past 30 days, put a tag on them if they hit a threshhold

    Button to automatically accept people who are 18+ Verified into 18+ Only Groups or decline certain Player Ranks / Game time / User Creation Date from joining/requesting to join

    Groups should have shared Recorded list to auto Warn, kick or ban's for players and if it becomes a high amount they will have a icon over there head for moderation to find them easier (Maybe even a optional automated system)

    Button to make Vrchat Groups 21+ 25+ 30+ Only

    Option to Be specific with your age on your profile or Age Badge

    Show the 18+ Badge on the player's nameplate (Or the specific age they enter)

    Always show they're 18+ Verified no hiding the badge

    Free 18+ Verification (Really doubt this one will happen)

    For groups that allow 18= and 18+ show how many users in the world are Verified vs not by an icon overhead

    slur filter in pronouns or bio 

    Official VRChat Moderators (Global) I think if moderation happens to a user it should automatically make a 2-5 minute clip before the action
title: Moderation Tool Suggestions
